FrequentlyQuestion8: How to use Migii on your computer (PC)?
FrequentlyQuestion8Answer:
At the moment, Migii does not support the website version, so to use the application on your computer, you need to follow these steps:

1. Install Android emulator on your computer

Popular Softwares:
- BlueStacks
- NoxPlayer
- LDPlayer

You can easily find the links to download this software on the Internet.

2. After installing one of the above software, you open that software, then you can use your computer as an Android device.
You open Google Play, search and install the Android version Migii to use.

tutorial_route_1:
The route is broken down into each type of test available in the standard TOEIC test.
These types of lessons are arranged by Migii Instructors in the order that it is easiest to achieve a passing score.
tutorial_route_2: Each type of lesson will have a score goal set by the Migii Instructors. To get the TOEIC passing score, you need to achieve these target scores.
tutorial_route_3:
The route consists of 3 levels, each with a certain date route. You will need to practice a certain number of exercises each day, in addition to tests or mock exams.
You will need to complete a sufficient number of exercises - assessment or mock exams to be carried over to the next day, remember this.
tutorial_route_4:
To participate in Practice, there are 2 ways:
- Press the Start button directly in the Roadmap screen
- Or open the exam at the home screen and select the type of lesson recorded in the Roadmap.
tutorial_route_5: To participate in the Assessment, press the Start button directly in the Route screen.
tutorial_route_6: To participate in the mock test, there are 2 ways, directly press the Start mock test button in the Route screen, or open the mock test screen, select the level and select the mock test you want to take.
tutorial_route_7: The practice time for each type of exercise can be shortened if you meet the conditions.
